growth.tokenBasisTip: Tokens are fresh input plus output. Prompt-cache reads and writes are listed separately and not counted, so repeated context is not counted again.
growth.stalePossible: Data may be out of date
growth.quotaErrNotSignedIn: Not signed in to {provider}. Sign in to that CLI in a terminal first; Agent Pets never asks for your credentials.
growth.quotaErrExpired: The {provider} sign-in has expired. Sign in again in that CLI, then retry.
growth.quotaErrTimeout: The request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
growth.quotaErrRateLimited: The quota service is rate limiting requests. Wait a minute and try again.
growth.quotaErrUnavailable: Could not load the {provider} quota right now. Try again later.
growth.quotaKeptLast: Could not refresh. Showing the last successful reading.
growth.autoRefreshNote: Auto-refresh every 2 minutes while the panel is open
growth.quotaEmptyBody: Sign in to the Codex or Claude Code CLI and your subscription quota will appear here.
